profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: I am a Computer Science graduate looking to expand my skill set. From being an apprentice at a successful start-up to being acquired by a larger software company, I have grown to be a more accomplished software engineer. My skills range from Python development and client engagement to technical research and team communication. I use peer criticism as a way to improve my work and offer more to my business.

positions.title: Professional development
positions.description: Exploring areas of programming and expanding my knowledge of data engineering and artificial intelligence. I am pursing certifications within Azure.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Design and structure custom Python processes for multiple unique client engagements
Maintain MongoDB data integrity with Python scripts
Develop solutions utilizing Salesforce API upon client request
Identify customer support issues and deliver solutions
Developed training for new associates

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Handle client integrations.
